Logstash output plugin to sign and export logstash events to Amazon Elasticsearch Service
A logstash plugin that allows to send logs to AWS CloudWatch Logs service.

repo_meta_data.description: This input plugin for Logstash scans a specified DynamoDB table and then reads changes to a DynamoDB table from the associated DynamoDB Stream.This gem is a Logstash plugin required to be installed on top of the Logstash core pipeline. This gem is not a stand-alone program.
